title: Construction and validation of a novel nutrient-based index for risk of aging using an interpretable machine learning framework: results from two population-based studies
summary: An interpretable machine-learning framework constructed a dietary aging risk index and tested associations with phenotypic age, accelerated aging and mortality in the Guangzhou cohort, with NHANES replication; these are observational associations. The publisher lists 2025/12; the first version reporting this result is dated 2025-12-29.
